Commentary.Commentary: After seeing it out till Lunch, Misbah-ul-Haq has found it's enough and on 227/2, has decided to it's time to have a go with the ball. Riding on Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq's fifties, they are now in a commanding position and will look to scalp as many wickets as they can today. Two whole sessions still left today, remains to be seen if West Indies can hold their nerve and dig deep. Stay tuned as the 4th and final innings is coming up.
So, the news breaking out from the middle is that PAKISTAN HAVE DECLARED. The rollers are out and we can see the Pakistan bowlers warming up. West Indies have a target of 456 set in front of them.

We had felt that the visitors were looking a bit downcast when they took the field this morning and not surprisingly, that reflected in their bowling. Cummins bowled with some aim and got a wicket but the rest, well... better left unsaid. Bishoo was disappointing as well, not trying to hit the rough enough. Join us back at 1410 IST (0840 GMT) for the second session.

The lead barely matters if you are supporting Pakistan or West Indies because it is looking like water above your head without you knowing how to swim. For the stats, it is 455 and Misbah might want to bat till an hour after Lunch, to try and push it close to 500 and then declare, with around 4-and-a-half sessions to bowl out the Windies.

SESSION 1 ANALYSIS - 113/1 IN 28 OVERS. Not a bad over rate but a wonderful run rate by Pakistan. Just 7 fours hit but plenty of singles taken in this period. West Indies are trying to limit the damage by spreading the field but the hosts are more than content in rotating the strike and going around merrily.
Full ball on the stumps, Younis Khan presents a tight defensive shot. Gets behind the line and comfortably keeps it out. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Flatter ball on middle and leg, Khan is hit on the pads as he tries to put bat on ball.
Shafiq plays this with the spin and turns it towards square leg for one run.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Floated well around the off stump, Asad closes the face a little too early and gets a leading edge on the off side which falls safely.
Short and turning in on middle and off, Younis gets back and slaps it down to long on for a single.
Khan drives this full delivery through the cover region and takes a run.
Full on the stumps, hit down to long on for a single.
Pushed a bit quicker through the air, it's shorter in length as well, Shafiq goes back and punches it square towards point.
Flighted well outside off, Younis Khan drives it through the covers and gets a single to his name.
Tossed up delivery well outside off, Shafiq brings the wrists into play and wrists it down to long on for one.
Low full toss on middle and off, played back to the bowler.
Another back foot defense from the batsman to end the over.
Flatter trajectory and pitched on a length, Younis goes back and brings his bat ahead to solidly keep it out.
Asad Shafiq works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Floats it up outside off, it's driven through towards sweeper cover for two good runs.
Fullish on middle and leg, it's turned to the on side for nothing.
Brathwaite gives this plenty of air, but it's too full on middle and off, it's drilled down to long on for a single.
KRAIGG BRATHWAITE to bowl as Jason Holder hopes for a wicket before Lunch.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Spinning in on middle and leg, turned around the corner for a run.
17th Test Fifty for Asad Shafiq. His second in the match.

FOUR! Great way to bring up his half century. Short and outside off, some drift there for Roston Chase, Shafiq gets back and cuts it late. Plays it fine enough and sends it across the third man fence, beating Marlon Samuels who was chasing it down.
Full on the stumps, Asad uppishly flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, punched through covers off the back foot for a single.
Loopy and turning in from around off, Shafiq plays with the spin and turns it towards square leg for a single.
Some reverse swing here for Jason Holder. He spears it in full and around off, swinging in, pushed back to the bowler to the end the over.
Fuller in length and once again it's outside off, driven straight to the man at mid off.

FOUR! This shot is a thing of beauty. Jason Holder with a half-volley outside off, Younis Khan plants his front foot forward and with an excellent straight bat, drives it back past mid off to send it all the way.
Full and angling in on middle and off, Khan wrists it towards mid on, kicking his back leg in the air as always.
Another full delivery around off, it's driven back in the direction of the bowler.
Holder with a full ball coming in on middle and leg, Younis works it to short mid-wicket with a closed face.
Flat and on a length, outside off, Younis Khan punches it through covers off his back foot and takes a single to end the over.
Loopy and full on the stumps, it's worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated on middle and leg, it's worked to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Same strategy as the previous over. Comes over the wicket to Asad Shafiq and loops it up on middle and off, it's driven down to long on for one more.
Chase continues from around the wicket to Younis Khan and tosses it up around off, it's played down to long on for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full outside off, Shafiq drives it to mid off.
Tailing back in from outside off, Khan pushes it in front of covers and takes a single.

Not out! Strange decision to take the review. Even in real time it seemed like it was going down. Holder bowls a length ball and it's angling in sharply. Younis Khan walks across to flick it across the line but misses and is rapped on the pads. Holder turns around and appeals but the umpire isn't interested. The West Indian skipper then decides to take the review and the decision goes upstairs. Replays confirm what I, and most people, thought. It was missing leg and so, Younis Khan survives.

We have some entertainment here! Jason Holder reckons that he has trapped Younis Khan in front. However, the umpire has not given it out. Holder reviews it. Is there an inside edge? Is it missing leg? The third umpire will give his decision in a bit...
Another ball which is fuller in length, it's played towards mid on once more by covering the line of the ball.
Full and coming in on middle and leg, it's driven towards mid on.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
Full and outside off, Shafiq gets outside the line and defends it to the leg side.
Another long hop, outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Comes around to Younis, bowls it shorter and quicker outside off, Khan looks to cut but misses.
Short and wide outside off, from over the wicket to Shafiq, cut through the covers for a run.
Comes from around the wicket, bowls it on middle, tossing it up a bit, Younis pushes it towards long on for a single.
Full and outside off, coming in, watchfully defended.

FOUR! That is a fine shot. Shafiq covers the line, gets across the stumps and flicks the incoming delivery through the leg side. Now there is a short mid-wicket in place and a mid on but the shot bisects them to perfection, beating mid-wicket's dive. The stand is worth 32 from just 50 balls. Shafiq moves to 43.
Full and outside off, comes in again, pushed towards cover.
Outside off, YK waits for the ball to come to him and gently opens the face of his bat to push it to sweeper cover for a single. The lead is now worth 420.
Fuller this time, around off, Khan comes forward again and taps it to the mighty Jason.
Landed around off, Younis defends it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, AS comes down the track and works it slightly wide of short mid-wicket but does not run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, this time Asad punches it behind point and gets a run.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Shafiq looks to cut but the ball spins in a bit, cramps him for room and he mistimes it to backward point.

There is some issue. One of the advertisement hoardings is uncovered and the sun shining on it is causing a glare. The umpire gets that covered and now there is a glare from another side but that is not bothering Shafiq so play resumes.
Around middle and off, Younis punches it to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good delivery, landed around off, comes in quickly, I mean quickly enough off the pitch to catch Shafiq but he recovers quickly and manages to defend.
Strays on the pads, Younis gets across, falls over a bit but manages to flick it to fine leg for a single. Moves to 10.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a good length outside off, Younis defends it back to the bowler.
JASON HOLDER brings himself on to bowl.
Full and around off, worked wide of mid on for one.
Shortish around off, Shafiq goes back to pull initially but perhaps does not find the length to his exact liking. Punches it down to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
Short and outside off, Shafiq looks to cut but misses.
Comes forward and pushes it to mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Younis lunges to defend.

ROSTON CHASE is brought into the bowling attack. He took the field just a few minutes ago. Normally, you cannot bowl immediately once you are off the field and Chase was not on the ground for the whole day yesterday. But since it is an external injury, the time factor is excused.

Full again, on middle, Younis gets across and plays a flamingo flick, with his back leg in the air. The ball goes to deep mid-wicket and the batsmen take a run. The stand moves to 20 from just 27 balls.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, pushed down to mid on.
Half volley outside off, Asad comes forward and drives it wide of mid off for a couple. The lead moves to 410.

Full and around off, Shafiq comes forward and drives it beautifully down the ground. But Marlon Samuels is quick to the ball, running to his left from mid on to stop the ball. He returns the throw, we assume to the keeper, because he turns blind and throws. Now, that could have hit anyone. The batsmen, the bowler or even the umpire. Luckily for all the human beings, the ball evades everyone and goes somewhere near first slip and Hope stops it.
A low full toss outside off, jabbed towards gully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off again, well kept out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off for a run.
Down the leg side, Shafiq gets across and turns it behind square for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side for a single.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Outside off, Younis pushes it towards point and sets off for a single. The fielder comes charging in and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Shafiq dived in but would have been out had the throw hit the stumps.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Works it down the leg side for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.

NO BALL. A lovely ball but it is not legal. Bowls a yorker, but oversteps. It is outside off and Younis looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge towards square leg. A single taken. PAKISTAN NOW LEAD BY 400.
Outside off, played straight to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Comes down the track, takes it on the full and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Full and wide outside off, Younis leans and drives it through the covers for a slowly run single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended with bat in front of pad.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Fullish on middle and leg, Younis gets across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark. Cummins has figures at 5-0-16-1 as of now.
Another widish ball outside off, not played at.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
YOUNIS KHAN is the next batsman in, replacing Azhar Ali.

OUT! Stop the press, West Indies have a wicket! That is a sharp catch. A fuller ball outside off, Azhar looks to flash hard but is too close to the ball and gets a healthy outside edge. The ball flies thick and fast and Jason Holder reacts well to take a catch at widish slip, close to a gullyish position, over his head. Azhar misses out on a century and the 71-run stand is broken. PAKISTAN ARE EFFECTIVELY 392/2.
WIDE. That is way outside off, almost outside the pitch, AA leaves it alone. The umpire does not let it go and stretches his arms for a wide.
Back of a length outside off, Ali is surprised by the little bit of extra bounce on that one and somehow guides it behind point for a couple. The lead moves to 391. The stand moves to 70.
FOUR! Glorious! Full and wide outside off, Azhar leans into this one and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Tossed up around off, it's eased to covers to end the over.
Loopy from the leg spinner once more, tosses it up on middle stump, Shafiq dispatches it with the sweep shot and picks up a double as the fielder from deep mid-wicket cuts it off.
Devendra floats this one up around off, Asad Shafiq prods forward and blocks.
Drags the length back on this and pitches it on the stumps, hit between mid-wicket and mid on.
Loopy delivery from the leggie, some lovely dip for Bishoo once more, pushed uppishly to the left of the bowler for nothing.
Drifting and dipping in on middle and leg, worked to the on side for no run.
Another back foot punch from Azhar Ali sees the ball go to the cover region. Dot ball to end the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a good length and outside off, punched straight to the short cover fielder for nothing.
Azhar Ali pushes this fuller ball nicely through the gap in the covers and runs hard to pick up two runs.
Length delivery on middle and leg, easily tucked through square leg and a single is taken.
Fullish in length and attacking the stump, Shafiq works this in front of mid-wicket for no run.
MIGUEL CUMMINS is brought into the attack.
Shafiq waits for it and turns it against the spin on the leg side for a single.

Very, very loopy, a lot of air given to it by Bishoo, it's driven to the right of mid on. Carlos Brathwaite, the substitute fielder, runs to his right and puts in a very good dive to stop the ball from going past him. Two runs are taken.
Loopy and dipping outside off, the Pakistan opener opens his body up and drops it in front of point for a brisk run.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's swept through mid-wicket as a single is taken.
Beautiful ball. Devendra Bishoo loops it up around off, it's pitched just back of a driving length, inviting Shafiq forward to play. It's blocked solidly on the off side.
Fuller and flatter on middle and off, turning away, Azhar kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Full ball well outside off, no way Asad Shafiq is going to bother himself with that. Shoulders his arms to it as the keeper collects it in his gloves.
Fullish in length once more, well outside off, Shafiq comes forward and across and blocks it in front of covers.
Fractionally fuller in length outside off, driven straight to the short cover fielder.
Length delivery outside off, Asad dabs it towards point with an open face and immediately shouts "NO". Sends his partner back as the fielder comes across to cut it off.

Extremely full and fired outside off, Asad Shafiq reaches out to this one and plays it nicely through covers for two runs. Was nicely placed in the gap so the batsmen had no trouble in coming back for the second.
Full and angling in on middle and leg, it's clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
50-run stand is up between the two. Pakistan's lead has swelled to 371.
Floats this one up on the stumps, Shafiq bends down on his rear knee and brings out the sweep shot through square leg for a brace.
Loopy and full outside off, eased through the covers for one more.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Tad shorter outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for one run.
Bowls it slower through the air and pitches it outside off, Azhar comes forward and solidly blocks.
Tossed up delivery outside off, pushed nicely through the covers for a single.

FOUR! Poor from the West Indian pacer and it's no trouble for Azhar Ali to put this away. It's too full and going down leg, no trouble for the Pakistan ODI skipper to help it on its way across the fine leg boundary.

Two Leg Byes! That was just angling down. Shannon arrows it in full and on middle and leg, goes off Azhar Ali's pads as he tries to flick it away. Two leg byes are taken as the ball rolls down the leg side.
Full delivery tailing in on middle and leg, it's flicked through towards the deep mid-wicket fielder as the batsmen take two runs.
Gabriel comes running in and fires it in full on middle and leg, Azhar stays behind the line and works it in front of mid-wicket with a closed face.
Fuller in length and outside off, Azhar Ali drives it hard but it's straight to the man at short cover.
Length delivery on the fifth stump line, driven to covers for nothing.
Another tossed up delivery on the stumps which is blocked back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up leg-spinner on middle stump, Azhar Ali kneels down and this time sweeps it down towards fine leg for a single.
Full and on the stumps, blocked.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, Ali gets low to this one and paddles it behind square on the leg side. Hope runs to the ball and ensure that the batsmen don't take a run.
Good delivery to start off with as Bishoo bowls a loopy leg breaker around off, nice flight and dip on that as Azhar Ali comes forward to block it out.
Maintains it on a length and pitches it outside off, Azhar opens his body up a bit and punches it through point for a single. That'll be the end of the over.
Good length delivery from Gabriel, tight line as it's in the channel outside off, solid defensive shot from Azhar Ali as he taps it on the off side.

FOUR! Width on offer and that's been put away. Back of a length delivery outside off, Azhar Ali just throws his bat at this. Gets a thick outside edge as the ball races away across the third man fence for a boundary.
Speared in full once more, outside off, Asad Shafiq punches this square past point and picks up a single as the fielder gives it the chase.
Fullish in length once more as Gabriel keeps it around the off stump line, pushed in front of covers.
Shannon Gabriel with a length delivery which is angling in from outside off, it's kept out well as Shafiq stays perfectly behind the line and defends it with a solid, straight bat.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Asad Shafiq prods forward to block but it goes off the inside edge to the on side. A single is taken.
Bishoo flights it well and lands it outside off, Asad drives it through the cover region and gets two runs to his name.
Drifting in on middle and leg, once again there's a little dip here, it's kept out solidly off the front foot and into the track.
Some dip for Bishoo, he pitches it around off, Shafiq gets right behind the line and blocks it to the left of the bowler.
Flat and straying on the pads, it's comfortably worked through mid-wicket for another run.
Overpitched from Bishoo, outside off, Asad Shafiq drills it out through the cover region and picks up an easy single.
Full outside off, it's driven but it's straight to the fielder at covers, who is standing right at the edge of the circle.
Pitches it up this time, and bowls a much better line as well. Tighter as it's around the off stump. Azhar Ali plants his front foot forward and blocks it out on the off side.
Length delivery outside off, once again it's shaping away, left alone once more.
On a good length once more and it's well outside off, a hint of away movement, no trouble for Azhar to lean forward and shoulders his arms to it.
On a length and pitched outside off, quite harmlessly really as the opener leaves it alone.
Gabriel comes steaming in and fires in a full ball around off, Azhar Ali leans forward and drives it towards the cover region.
SHANNON GABRIEL will bowl from the other end.
Flatter one on mid-wicket, worked to mid-wicket to end the over.
Floats this one up just around the off stump, it's kept out off the front foot and into the track.
Juicy full toss around off, Asad Shafiq misses out on this one as he pushes it back to Bishoo.
On a length and turning away from around off, Shafiq goes back and crunches it to deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Looped up on middle and leg, it's worked through to deep square leg for a single.
Bishoo starts off with an overpitched delivery outside off, Azar Ali drives it square on the off side for nothing.

We are ready for play to resume. The overnight batsmen, AZHAR ALI and ASAD SHAFIQ walk out to the middle. West Indies are already looking downcast, does not seem like a positive sign. It will be DEVENDRA BISHOO to start off proceedings to Azhar. Here we go....

PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan says that the pitch has deteriorated. It has opened up. There are some footmarks near the batsmen, so the spinners will get purchase. Near the good length area, in line of the stumps, the cracks have widened. In short, batting will be difficult.

The Windies do not have to go far to search for inspiration. Devendra Bishoo bowled them into contention in the first Test at Dubai and they nearly pulled off a miraculous win. With the cracks on the pitch opening up, Bishoo might look for an encore. But still, they will be batting last and need to be mindful of the same.

It was a slow but good day for Pakistan on Sunday as they claimed ascendancy. They restricted the Windies to 224, getting a lead of 228 and then have batted well again to swell it to 342. With 6 sessions left, their minimum target will be 500, or perhaps try and bat till an hour after Lunch to take victory out of West Indies' reach. Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth day of the second Test between Pakistan and West Indies at Abu Dhabi.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

Earlier in the day, Pakistan bowled really well to take six wickets and bowl out the Windies for 224. Yasir Shah shone with the ball as he took a 4-fer. The pace duo of Rahat Ali and Sohail Khan took five between them. The hosts are in the driver's seat and would look to bat for about two more sessions. It would be an uphill task for the visitors to come back from here. Let's see if they are able to fight back tomorrow and bring the match alive. Do join us for all the action on Day 4. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

A fruitful day for Pakistan again. The extended final session has also belonged to the home side as they scored 114 runs and have swelled the lead to 342. The opening pair of Aslam and Ali stitched together a steady 93-run partnership. The former reached his 4th Test fifty but departed just after that in a bizarre manner to Gabriel. Ali though has carried on and is unbeaten on 52. The West Indies bowlers have tried hard but the home side has been too good for them.

FOUR BYES! Apt to summarize West Indies in this Test! Gabriel slants it way down the leg side, Shafiq cannot clip that one. Hope dives to his left but cannot get a hand to it. The ball runs down to fine leg fence. Byes signaled and that is STUMPS, DAY 3!
Fuller in length again, Azhar does not cover the swing but gets it through mid-wicket for a single. That swung in late.
On a length outside off, Azhar comes forward and pushes it to covers.
21st Test fifty for Azhar Ali!
FOUR! FIFTY! Fuller outside off, Azhar drives it hard and gets it through point for a boundary. That also brings up his fifty!
BEATEN! Fuller length outside off, Azhar plays at it and is beaten all ends up.
On a length outside off, Azhar defends it back down the wicket.
Another block by Shafiq to this one outside off.
Floated outside off, Shafiq comes forward and defends it.
Goes round the wicket!
Floated outside off, Shafiq comes forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, cut towards covers by Shafiq.
Fuller in length on off, Azhar drives it through mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut through point for a single.
Angled in a length on off, comes in, worked with the swing through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, defended towards covers by Shafiq.
On a length on off, played back down the wicket.
Fuller in length on off, Shafiq blocks it. Gabriel overstepped this time. Another no ball!
Fuller outside off, Shafiq comes forward and defends it to covers.
On a length outside off, left alone by Shafiq again.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Shafiq.
Shafiq cuts it hard through cover-point for a single.
Works this one through wide mid on for a single. 100 up for Pakistan!
Shorter outside off, cut through covers for a single.
Another rock solid defense from Shafiq.
Shafiq comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Fuller outside off, pushed to covers by Shafiq.

Just short! Angled on a length outside off, Azhar hangs his bat out for it and gets an outside edge. The ball just drops short of the keeper Hope who dives to his right to take that one. Gabriel has bowled well again.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Ali.
Fuller outside off, Azhar drives it through extra cover for a couple.
Another leave for Ali.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Hurled wide outside off on a length, Azhar throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Hint of reverse there.
Shafiq mistimes his back foot pull back down the wicket.
Fuller in length, driven to mid on by Shafiq.
Shorter outside off, Azhar punches it down to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut through point for a single.
Floated outside off, played back to the bowler by Shafiq.
Shorter outside off, punched to covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Shafiq.
ASAD SHAFIQ walks in.

OUT! This is bizarre! Fuller and going down leg, Aslam looks to clip it through but looks to have missed it. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire says no. Gabriel wants it reviewed. Holder agrees to it. The replays however show there was no bat there. Wonder why the keeper and bowler were so confident. This isn't even an ODI where you appeal to distract the umpire from giving it a wide. But hold on, the third umpire thinks it is out for some reason. We are not sure if there was any evidence to overturn the on-field call. Aslam cannot believe his luck!
West Indies review as Aslam is not given out caught behind as per them.
Slanted down the leg side, Aslam fails to clip it.
Fuller outside off, Azhar pushes it through covers for a single.
4th Test fifty for Sami Aslam!
FIFTY! Fuller on off, Aslam pushes it to mid on and gets to his fifty. He raises his bat to acknowledge the applause.
Starts with a yorker on off, Aslam digs it out back to the bowler.
SHANNON GABRIEL back on to bowl now.
Floated on middle, Azhar keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, driven through cover-point for a single.
Too full on middle, turned towards the on side by Aslam.
Aslam comes forward and defends it.
Flatter outside off, Aslam defends it back.
Flatter on the pads, Aslam works it through square leg.
Flatter on off, Azhar pushes it towards covers off his crease.
Fuller on off, Aslam nudges it through square leg for a single.
Floated on off, Aslam comes forward and defends it.
On the pads, Azhar clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Azhar punches it to covers.
Flatter on the pads, Azhar looks to clip but is hit on his pads.
FOUR! Deft! Shorter outside off, Aslam gets across and pulls it into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Aslam comes forward and defends it.
Shorter one coming in, Azhar helps it through square leg for a single.
Ali looks to clip that one but fails to connect.
Shorter length but going down leg, Azhar looks to work it away but fails to put bat to ball.
On a length angling in, tucked through square leg for a single.
Azhar comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Drops it short on off, Azhar just about keeps it out with an angled bat.
Shorter on off, punched to covers by Azhar Ali.
Aslam sweeps this one through square leg for a single.
Turns it through square leg for a single.
Outside leg, Azhar gets an edge towards point.
Spears in a yorker at 132 kph, kept out by Aslam.
FOUR! Hit away! Shorter again on off, Aslam picks it and pummels it through square leg for a boundary.
Bouncer! Short one comes from outside off, comes in, Aslam just about evades it in time.
Aslam comes forward and defends this one.
A touch short outside off, Aslam looks to throw his bat at it but is beaten.
Good length outside off, left alone.
This one is swept behind square on the leg side for a single.
Ouch! Floated outside off, Aslam sweeps it hard but hits short leg.
Driven to mid off for a single by Ali.
Fuller on middle, Azhar pushes it back down the wicket.

DRINKS!
On a length on off, Aslam tucks it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Aslam comes forward and defends it.
Length ball on off, Aslam comes forward and defends.
On a length outside off, Aslam looks to play at it but is beaten.
Aslam plays this one towards point.

JASON HOLDER comes on to bowl. He has already lost his run-up twice here.
Shorter length on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Azhar looks to work it through the on side but gets hit on his pads.
Floated outside leg, Azhar comes forward and defends it.
